question: Should ageing itself be classified as a disease?
answer: Ageing is the main risk factor for cancer, heart disease and dementia, and its mechanisms can be slowed in animals. Regulators approve drugs for diseases, so a medicine that delays ageing itself has no clear route to approval. Naming it a disease would open trials of drugs aimed at the cause, not its consequences.
move: Whichever side you took, what the label would change in practice is the hinge.
ask: What would a label change in real life, before I argue over its name?
counterpoint: A condition every person develops is the baseline against which disease is defined. Labelling old age a disease invites doctors to write it on death certificates instead of finding treatable causes, and hands marketers a licence. After objections, the WHO withdrew old age as a diagnosis from its new classification in 2022. Trials can target specific age-related conditions.
source: Bulterijs et al., Frontiers in Genetics, 2015
reference: Bulterijs, Hull, Björk & Roy, It is time to classify biological aging as a disease, Frontiers in Genetics, 2015
